title: Design System: MQ Competitive Programming Club

accent.note: Cool/dark theme swaps this role to Neon Orange #ff9440.

body.purpose: Paragraphs and UI text; native system sans, ~64ch measure.

label.purpose: The whole 'code' vernacular — eyebrows, tags, nav, captions, terminal. JetBrains Mono; two fixed sizes (12px, 15px).

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: The hero terminal panel only. Note: --shadow-color is theme-tinted (warm 38 16% 32% light / cool 240 40% 2% dark).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call-to-action (hero 'Getting Started', form submits).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-2); min-height: 34px; padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--accent-ink); background: var(--accent); border: 1.5px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius-md); cursor: pointer; transition: background 90ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), transform 90ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); border-color: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary action — white surface with a strong hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: var(--space-2); min-height: 34px; padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-strong); background: var(--surface); border: 1.5px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); cursor: pointer; transition: background 90ms, border-color 90ms; } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: var(--paper-sunk); border-color: var(--ink-muted); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Identity-Stripe Card
components.description: The recurring card: white surface, hairline border, a 3px identity-coloured top stripe, lifts on hover.
components.html: Topic Roadmap12 ordered topics from two-pointers to flows.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-3); padding: var(--space-5); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-top: 3px solid var(--cat-6, #4f8da1); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / 0.10); text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 4px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / 0.08), 0 4px 12px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / 0.10); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-strong); } .ds-card-body { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Pill
components.description: Mono uppercase tag. Accent variant is the badge form (e.g. 'ICPC PREP').
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2); padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-3); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper-sunk); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); } .ds-pill-accent { color: var(--accent-text); background: var(--accent-tint); border-color: transparent; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill); background: var(--accent); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Mono nav link with an animated accent underline; active/hover also takes the accent text colour.
components.css: .ds-navlink { position: relative; padding: var(--space-3) 0; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease; } .ds-navlink::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -6px; height: 2px; background: var(--accent); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 160ms ease; } .ds-navlink:hover, .ds-navlink[data-active="true"] { color: var(--accent-text); } .ds-navlink:hover::after, .ds-navlink[data-active="true"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-navlink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: The '>' prompt marker generated before every section heading — a signature of the terminal vernacular.
components.css: .ds-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-3); margin: 0; font-family: 'Libre Franklin', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--ink-strong); } .ds-heading::before { content: '>'; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 400; font-size: 0.7em; line-height: 1; color: var(--accent-text); }

narrative.northStar: MQ Competitive Programming Club — a terminal/code aesthetic on warm paper, shipped in two temperatures of one identity (warm light default, cool indigo dark). Named after the app; no separate metaphor.
narrative.overview: A static, content-driven site for a university competitive-programming club. The design is a terminal/code aesthetic on warm paper: JetBrains Mono labels, a {} brand mark, $ and > prompts, macOS-style window panels, on a warm beige ground with soft Color Crush pastels for wayfinding. It ships two themes of one identity, differing only in palette temperature — warm light (pastel + rose) and cool indigo dark (deep indigo + neon orange); the code core is identical in both. The tone is approachable rigour: serious contest prep that stays beginner-kind, never edgy or intimidating.
keyCharacteristics: Two temperatures of one identity (warm light default, cool indigo dark) — role tokens, not hardcoded colour.
A terminal/code vernacular: {} mark, $/> prompts, mono labels, window-title-bar panels.
Warm neutral paper (not white) as the ground; clean white surfaces sit on it.
Six pastel identity hues, kept distinct from green/amber/red status colours.
Flat by default — hairline borders and tonal layering carry structure; shadows are theme-tinted and rare.
Restrained, precise, human; personality lives in the details, not decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Temperature Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a role token, never a hardcoded hex. Warm/light is default; the cool/indigo theme swaps every role including the accent hue (rose → neon orange) and the shadow tint. New UI that reads roles themes for free.

rules.name: The Two-Language Rule
rules.body: The six pastels mean identity (what a thing is); green/amber/red mean status/difficulty. Never colour a card stripe by difficulty, never use a pastel to signal state.

rules.name: The Rare-Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent marks actions and the current thing (buttons, active nav, the > prompt), not surfaces. A screen washed in accent is wrong.

rules.name: The Two-Label-Sizes Rule
rules.body: Mono/label text uses exactly two fixed-px sizes — 12px and 15px — not the rem body scale. Snap to one; don't add an 11/13/14px one-off.

rules.name: The Mono-Vernacular Rule
rules.body: The code voice — // eyebrows, the > heading prompt, $ terminal lines, the {} mark — is always JetBrains Mono. Chrome and labels only, not body copy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest — borders and tone do the work. A shadow appears only as a response (hover) or for the single hero panel.

dos: Do read colours from role tokens (var(--accent), var(--ink), var(--cat-N)) so new UI themes in both temperatures for free.
Do keep the terminal vernacular where it belongs: // eyebrows, the > heading marker, $ prompts, JetBrains Mono labels, the {} mark.
Do use the six pastels as identity and green/amber/red as status — and keep them apart.
Do stay flat: hairline borders + tonal layering; shadow only on hover or the hero panel.
Do use the two label sizes (12/15px) for mono chrome, and arbitrary utilities for raw-px values (text-[14px]) — the 17px root makes rem tokens diverge from px.
Do hold WCAG AA on accent/text, and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't hardcode a hex in markup or components — it breaks a theme. One exception: dynamic per-item colours already sourced from --cat-N.
Don't add a gradient/glassmorphism hero, drop-shadow everything, or trade the flat papery terminal feel for generic-SaaS gloss.
Don't colour a card stripe by difficulty, or use a pastel to signal state.
Don't wash a screen in the accent — it marks actions and the current thing, not surfaces.
Don't introduce a third label size or reach for the rem scale for mono labels.
